title: Decomposability of Operators in Type $\mathrm{I}_k$ von Neumann Algebras
summary: Let $\mathcal{H}$ be a complex Hilbert space and $\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H})$ be the algebra of all bounded linear operators on $\mathcal{H}$. For $A \in \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{H})$, we refer to the sequence $\{|A^{n}|^{1/n}\}_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ as the normalized power sequence of $A$. In this article, we study the norm convergence property, i.e. convergence of normalized power sequence in the norm topology for operators belonging to type $\mathrm{I}_k$ von Neumann algebras acting on a separable complex Hilbert space.
